messages:
Hannah R: heads up @eng-security 1: while triaging a failing nightly build we found debug logs baked into the release artifact that contain truncated external partner API tokens. bucket was internal-only but tokens are valid. need immediate rotations and a patch to the build pipeline.

Mark D: ugh. which partner and which pipelines? any customer data?

Hannah R: partner: synclytics (internal codename). no customer PII observed, just API tokens and some request headers. affected pipelines: nightly-build and release-packager. we pulled the artifact and revoked access to the staging bucket.

security-oncall: automated scanner detected 5 token-like strings and created ticket SEC-7401. no external downloads in access logs. owners DM'd.

build-eng: proposed fix: remove debug log collector from build step and add an artifact sanitizer that strips secrets before packaging. quick patch ready:

```
# sanitize script example
sed -E 's/(token|api_key)=[A-Za-z0-9\-_.]{8,}/\1=<REDACTED>/g' -i build/output/*.log
zip -r release.zip build/output
```

build-eng: we'll push the patch to release-packager now and block the nightly-build job until we've sanitized artifacts.

ci-bot: Created pipeline run PR #842: disable debug-collector + add sanitizer. CI will run tests. Link: https://redwood.internal/ci/runs/842

platform-ops: immediate actions: 1) rotate the exposed partner tokens (security team to coordinate) 2) scan artifact storage for other artifacts containing token patterns (`secret-scan --path=gs://artifacts/ --pattern='(token|api_key)='`) 3) update CI policy to fail builds if sanitizer not present.

security-oncall: checklist posted: 1) rotate partner tokens and confirm with partner 2) sanitize and re-upload clean artifacts or rebuild 3) run org-wide artifact scan and attach report to SEC-7401 4) update CI config to enforce no-debug and sanitizer step 5) share short advisory to dev teams. mark actions done in this thread.

Hannah R: pinged partner ops, they rotated their tokens and confirmed. I'll attach their confirmation to SEC-7401.

Mark D: sanitizer merged and deployed to release-packager. kicked a rebuild of the affected artifacts.

build-eng: verified rebuilt artifacts have no token patterns. uploaded sanitized artifacts and removed old ones from staging bucket.

platform-ops: ran `secret-scan` across recent artifacts, found 2 other stale debug logs in experimental buckets; teams notified. ticket INFRA-4909 opened for cleanup.

security-oncall: closing automated alert after partner confirmation and artifact remediation. follow-up: new policy will require artifact sanitization and a CI gating rule by start of next sprint. if anyone else sees suspicious tokens, tag this thread or open SEC-7401.
